title: Staff Working Document SWD(2026) 237 final: Member States' data on minimum wage protection and action plans to promote collective bargaining
key_claim: Collective bargaining coverage across the EU ranges from almost 12% to 100%; Estonia (19.1%), Bulgaria (16.2%), Hungary (14.8%) and Poland (11.6%) are below 20%, and 18 Member States are below the 80% threshold.
frame_summary: Reports how far Member States are from the 80% bargaining-coverage target, which is the capacity any bargaining-led route for workplace AI would rely on.
verbatim_list: There are currently 18 Member States in which the collective bargaining coverage rate is lower than the 80% threshold set in Article 4(2) of the Directive (Graph 11).

title: AI, meet CBA
